entityDescription:
FireSafe is a wildfire intelligence company that combines real-time AI detection, geospatial risk analysis, and predictive modelling into a single integrated platform. FireSafe gives municipalities, utilities, insurers, and emergency-management agencies the intelligence to act before a wildfire becomes a disaster — identifying ignitions at the earliest stage, mapping exposure to the asset level, and forecasting fire behaviour to deliver hours of decision-making lead time rather than minutes.
Capabilities
FireSafe operates across three integrated layers. AI-powered detection monitors up to 2,800 sq km per unit, 24/7 and in all weather conditions, flagging ignitions before a 911 call is placed. Risk analysis maps vulnerabilities across an entire jurisdiction — infrastructure, residential zones, and critical assets — to support resource allocation and resilience planning. Predictive modelling simulates fire spread based on terrain, fuel load, weather, and historical data, supporting evacuation planning and operational response.
Earth Observation & Space Technology
FireSafe integrates geospatial satellite data and hyperspectral imagery to strengthen its modelling pipeline. Hyperspectral analysis is used to characterise vegetation and fuel load for vegetation-management programmes, while multi-source satellite Earth Observation data feeds the platform's risk, hazard, and predictive layers. This fusion of ground-based AI sensing with spaceborne imagery enables continuous, high-resolution monitoring of wildfire risk across large and remote landscapes.
Markets & Applications
FireSafe serves government, utility, insurance, and critical-infrastructure operators seeking quantified, defensible wildfire risk intelligence. The platform deploys in weeks and is engineered for demanding terrain and environmental conditions, supporting detection, mitigation, and emergency-response use cases at municipal, regional, and national scale.

The technology uses permanent magnets in both the stator and the rotor, while windings are used primarily for electromagnetic flux commutation and control.
The current laboratory prototype has been independently tested by Slovak academic partners and has demonstrated measured efficiency of approximately 89–94% at around 100–150 W, including power electronics, depending on the operating point and measurement conditions.
TorqueFuture is interested in cooperation with ESA, industrial and research partners for further technology optimisation, prototype validation and adaptation to space-relevant applications such as actuators, robotic mechanisms, positioning systems and long-duty drive subsystems where energy efficiency, thermal stability and reliability are critical.

description:
Are you looking for an innovative technology for aluminum welding or bimaterial assemblies? Is the economic competitiveness of welding an important criteria for you? Because innovation is at the heart of business concerns, StirWeld is democratizing Friction Stir Welding (FSW).

Stirweld team has developed a technology allowing the use of friction stir welding (FSW) on all types of CNC machine. We support you in the optimisation of your machine park and the integration of a new know-how to offer to your customers. Our FSW head for CNC offers identical performances as a special FSW machine (effort control, quality recording,...). Its other advantages:
-	Low investment cost compared to special machines or FSW robotic stations.
-	Adaptability: despite the absence of standard machining centres, the FSW head of Stirweld can be adapted to all CNC machines.
-	Easy to use and to install: after the first installation, the user can mount and dismount the FSW head in a few minutes, easily switching from machining to welding and vice versa. 
Our customers are in the automotive, space, aerospace and metal working industries.

Our products: welding heads, standardised FSW tools and tool holders, industrial study, training FSW.

Friction Stir Welding Head for CNC Machine
Our FSW head can weld from existing CNC machine tools, whether it is a 3, 4 or 5-axis machine. The Stirweld FSW head brings the FSW welding functions to the machining center: force control and recording, cooling, protection of the spindle against loads and vibrations. The offer of this equipment highly reduces the investment cost of an FSW machine while offering the same performance as a special FSW machine.

Friction Stir Welding tools
Striweld offer you 3 types of FSW tools:
-	FSW tools high strength aluminium,
-	FSW tools standard aluminium,
-	FSW tools Al/Fe, - FSW tools Al/Si.
Stirweld experts are here to advise you in the appropriate choice for your specific applications. FSW Stirweld tools are robust & powerful for a controlled cost.
Friction Stir Welding Tool Holders
Stirweld tool holders are compatible with all FSW machines: Stirweld FSW Head for NC machines, FSW special machines, FSW robots. Tool holders are available in two versions: 
-	Classic tool holder,
-	Smart tool holder with temperature measurement.
Our tool holders handle your tools for your milling or drilling operations or your friction stir welding operations.

FSW industrial study
Stirweld support you throughout all your project(s) to succeed your first FSW part:
-	Co-design of your parts,
-	Design & manufacturing of clamping jig,
-	Welding parameters & quality control,
-	Support & optimization.

FSW 3-day training
Stirweld experts offer you a training about Friction Stir Welding: 
-	Discovery of the FSW process, - How to weld from a CNC machine, 
-	The FSW process adjustment, 
-	Implementation of learnings on FSW machine,
-	Impact of FSW parameters on welding quality,
-	Production of typical FSW defect.

Friction Stir Welding Expertise
With a skilled and fully committed team, Stirweld aspires to conquer a new market: FSW at low cost.
Since 1995, FSW remains a technology reserved for high added value applications involving expensive equipment. Our expertise, which is the result of 15 years of experience, enables Stirweld team to develop a technology for FSW for all types of CNC.

entityDescription:
The Microsystems Laboratory - as the part of the HUN-REN Centre for Energy Research is intended to research and develop integrated sensors and sensor systems, MEMS and BioMEMS devices fabricated by silicon or polymer micro- and nanomachining technology. The activity covers the characterisation of novel functional materials, development of sensing principles, technology solutions and application-specific microsystems. The utilisation of micro- and nanomachining technology enables the miniaturisation of sensing and analytical systems and integration of various functions of sample preparation, sensing, readout, actuation or communication. The laboratory is focusing on the development of mechanical, physical, chemical (and biochemical) sensors, functional micro- and nanofluidic devices, implantable microsystems and infrared LED.

The Laboratory operates a unique infrastructure in Hungary, which is open for academic and industrial partners to fabricate (and to characterise) complex, purpose-designed microsystems, nanocircuits, as well as Lab-on-a-Chip devices and to develop their technology solutions. The Laboratory is a dedicated infrastructure of the HCHiP Chips Competence Centre, and the European network of Chips Competence Centers.
The high-tech microtechnology related fabrication and characterisation systems work in a class 10 cleanroom facility. The laboratory is dedicated for 3D processing of 4” Si / glass / polymer substrates with maximal resolution of 1µm, together with lithographic mask manufacturing. Electron beam lithography and focused ion beam (FIB) milling are also available with resolution of 20nm. Multi-domain Finite-Element Modelling (FEM), and process simulation also support the structural design and development. Wide spectra of characterisation techniques are also available: optical (fluorescent) and electron microscopy (SEM and EDS), atomic force microscopy (AFM), profilometry, optical and electrical measurements, electrochemical impedance spectroscopy, microfluidic characterisation, mechanical vibration and climate test chambers, UV-Vis / IR / FTIR / FLUORESCENT / RAMAN spectroscopy, etc.

Our business model combines chip sales (direct and via distributors such as Rutronik, Avnet, and Arrow) with IP licensing to semiconductor and fabless companies, especially in segments we do not directly address (e.g., consumer electronics). Licensing can generate earlier revenue because it requires less maturity than shipping full chips. We already partner with AMD and Siemens. AMD provides tools, reduced-price hardware for demonstrators, and distribution visibility for an FPGA IP prototype via its partners’ IP catalog. Siemens also provide free tools, as well as marketing and business connections with potential customers.

Our team consists of different specialists, such as engineers, programmers, foresters, and analysts. We have developed an innovative tool for detecting wildfires.

We started developing the algorithms and AI dedicated to detecting smoke in 2010. After a couple of years, we managed to create a powerful tool that can infallibly detect wildfires within minutes after the outbreak, with only a small percentage of false alarms caused by clouds, fog, or smog – and thanks to the constant progress of the IT industry, we are able to keep on perfecting our system. We trust that we have created an essential tool that is unique on a global scale.

The system is based on AI, machine learning, and deep learning. It detects wildfires within minutes after the outbreak from a distance of 15 km (~10 miles) and sends an alert immediately after. We hope that SmokeD will play a major role in fighting and preventing fires, as well as in protecting the environment, people, and their property.

As of now, we are surveilling over 3 million hectares of land globally with 190 intelligent cameras. Our detectors can detect fires within minutes, enabling earlier extinguishing efforts and significantly reducing potential risks to people, property, and the environment.
